title: Myeloma, myelodysplastic syndrome and lymphoma
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's blood cancer or its history (only that code).
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for multiple myeloma.

HPI
The patient is a 73-year-old woman presenting for a follow-up evaluation regarding her history of multiple myeloma. She has been under the care of oncology and is currently in remission following her initial course of treatment. She reports feeling well overall and denies any new bone pain, fatigue, or significant constitutional symptoms. She is currently adhering to her maintenance therapy and reports good tolerance to the medication without significant side effects.

Medication List
Lenalidomide 10 mg daily.

Exam
The patient appears well-nourished and in no acute distress. She is alert and oriented. Skin is intact and warm. Lungs are clear to auscultation bilaterally. Heart sounds are regular with no murmurs noted. Strength is symmetric in all four extremities.

Assessment
The patient is a 73-year-old female with multiple myeloma who is currently in remission. She is stable on her current maintenance regimen.

Plan
Continue current maintenance lenalidomide. Schedule follow-up in three months for repeat laboratory monitoring and clinical assessment.

Electronically signed, L. Moreau, DO, 05/12/2026
explanations: Multiple myeloma in remission: C90.01 (HCC 19). It is not a history code.

distractors.why: Myeloma in remission is coded with the remission code, not history.
